history.note: first observed
remediation recorded; pending verification by re-audit: Quotes that skip lines with '...' must contain at least 12 checkable characters, or they are UNCHECKABLE instead of OK.

re-audit verified the fix: quote_matches now returns None when the quote contains an elision ("..." or an ellipsis character) and its checkable segments total fewer than 12 characters. check_item turns None into UNCHECKABLE_QUOTE, which is in the UNCHECKED set, so these quotes no longer count as OK. A gap-heavy quote with 12 or more checkable characters is still allowed, as the note describes. A quote whose only gaps are [REDACTED] markers is not covered by the 12-character floor, because only elisions trigger it. That is a narrower, separate case.

3d0e1e0cf38ca9d1.title: Ledger load and save have no file locking, so concurrent CLI invocations can lose updates

history.note: first observed
remediation recorded; pending verification by re-audit: Commands that change the ledger now hold a lock file from read to write (ledger.locked), with tests.

re-audit verified the fix: Every path in the code that loads a ledger and then saves it now runs inside ledger.locked(). The lock is an O_CREAT|O_EXCL lock file at <ledger>.lock. It waits up to 30 seconds, removes lock files older than 600 seconds as stale, and releases in a finally block. Covered paths: _ledger_write (used by accept, revoke, legal, remediate and close) wraps load, change and save in the lock. cmd_packet holds the lock around _packet, which loads and saves the ledger. finalize.py line 76 holds the lock around load and the save at line 94 (based on the indentation I read; I did not read finalize.py's body). The only unlocked ledger load is the read-only ledger show, which cannot lose updates. Tests in tests/unit/test_ledger_gate.py (lines 217-243) cover lock creation and release, contention timeout, and stale-lock removal. Limitation: a lock held longer than 600 seconds could be treated as stale. That is a minor edge and does not undo the fix. I did not trace the finalize.py path beyond the grep lines.

remediations.note: Commands that change the ledger now hold a lock file from read to write (ledger.locked), with tests.
